schema_version: v0 — component-charter shape; migrates into the intention envelope when MAP.md Q6 lands
what: The instrument that answers one question per component, mechanically: WHERE IS THE LLM? It walks each component's shipped import closure (composing cairn.tools.import_sieve's reach walk rather than re-deriving it) to the one door that reaches the inference host, and returns a verdict. PURE DETERMINISTIC — no LLM anywhere, not at fire time and not at SLEEP; it may shell out to as many scripts as it likes. MOSTLY DETERMINISTIC — no LLM in the operational loop, but a seam the LLM runs through periodically, at SLEEP, to review feedback and update the deterministic parts. REACHES AN ORACLE — the LLM is in the operational loop, which is correct for the librarian, chat and /chart, and a defect exactly when the thing is a gate. THE SEAMS ARE THE CORPUS'S OWN FILENAMES: `live.py` (the stated LLM edge — librarian/live.py: 'trees.py stays import-pure; this thin edge is where the doors compose') and `nexus.py` (the question-nexus). They are excluded as ENTRY POINTS only — a seam the fire path imports anyway still counts, because then the LLM really is in the loop whatever the file is called. SHELL TARGETS ARE RESOLVED, not assumed: the literal argv head is read (`git`, `sudo`), and a computed argv comes back UNKNOWN and flags the verdict *UNPROVEN. OFF-BOX STATE IS REPORTED, NEVER GRADED — 5432, the trees and the network matter to replayability but psycopg2 is not an LLM, and grading them as oracles is the error the first cut shipped with. The roster is DISK: every directory holding an intention+why.json that ships code. `cairn determinism` is the door; it judges nothing about whether a component OUGHT to be pure, and the disposition is Akien's.
why: Akien, 2026-08-13, verbatim: 'we're sprinting toward akien can inspect the gates and inspectors and find them deterministic and mostly deterministic respectively. I want to SEE that before anything else. That's our base level thing above skills. but it has to be the thing those skills can depend on. I have to SEE that with my own eyes before we move on to anything else.' THE LIVED SYMPTOM: he cannot look at the layer his skills stand on and tell whether it holds. build_inspector's charter has asserted since 2026-07-27 that a gate is 'inference-free by construction ... a gate that consults an oracle is not a gate' and that its verdict is 'always HARDWARE' — a claim about a FIRE PATH that was readable, plausible and unfalsifiable at a glance for seventeen days. Law 3: an unmeasured claim is a hypothesis. Law 9: prose asserting green is not an earning. This walks the path so the claim can be wrong. WHY THE VERDICT IS ABOUT THE LLM AND NOT ABOUT FORKING — Akien's correction the same day, and it is the definition: 'i assume shell means requires running a script. DETERMINISTIC code can call other scripts. But Pure DETERMINISTIC means no LLM calls. So whatever shell scripts it calls can't make LLM calls. MOSTLY means the LLM does not run in the operational loop. But an LLM is called periodically, such as during SLEEP (we do have that idea) to review the feedback and update the deterministic components if needed.' What makes a verdict unreplayable is an oracle in the loop, not a fork.
invoke: `cairn determinism` — the whole report, most-replayable first; `cairn determinism --json` for the machine-readable one; `cairn determinism <root>` to walk a tree other than this repo. import: `from cairn.tools.determinism import determinism`. Prove: `python3 cairn/tools/determinism/proofs/test_determinism.py`.
node_class: tool — a complete primitive with USERS, not an owner (Law 6, ruling 2026-08-13-tools-have-users-not-owners). It holds no state: it reads the tree and returns a report, keeping nothing between calls, so there is nothing for an owner to gate. No runtime state, no daemon; fires when someone asks.
entry: FRESH build, 2026-08-13, composing import_sieve. Deliberate reuse on the record: the reach walk (`reaches`), the off-box ladder and the mention-vs-capability mesh belong to import_sieve and are imported, not copied (Law 1, I-borrow-patterns-cite-dont-graft). Re-deriving reach here would re-earn the two failures import_sieve's header records — a docstring's honest mention of inference_domain firing a grep, and a port number in an error string doing the same.
state_and_history: compiled to state.json (projected window) + history.json (append-only voyage) beside this charter.
how_it_learns: FROM THE GAP BETWEEN ITS VERDICT AND AKIEN'S. It emits a verdict per component and judges no component wrong, so a disagreement is always visible as his correction rather than as a silent pass — and it has already been corrected three times, each landing as physics rather than as a comment. (1) IT WAS BUILT ON THE WRONG AXIS. The first cut graded on 'does it leave the process', which made a `git` call disqualifying and reported 17 components as reaching an oracle when not one of them could reach the inference host. Akien re-cut it onto the LLM; tooth (b) is now a permanent trap for the old reading. (2) IT COLLAPSED THE FIRE PATH INTO THE LEARNING SEAM and reported build_inspector — THE gate — as consulting an oracle; the split is now physics, and tooth (g) pins the inverse so a filename cannot launder an oracle. (3) IT NAMED A COLUMN `GATES` when what it measures is a declared refusal class, which build_inspector's fire path does not have at all; narrowed to `REFUSES`. THE STANDING EDGE: gate-ness itself is still not derived — see filed edge (a).
filed_edges: (a) A GATE DECLARES ITSELF. Today gate-ness lives in prose (one charter says 'device (gate)', and it is stale — build_inspector berths as a machine since the rung move). Until a charter declares it in a field, this tool reports where the LLM is and CANNOT red a gate that consults an oracle, which is the check Akien actually wants. Ticket owed.

(b) A SHELLED BINARY THAT ITSELF CALLS AN LLM IS INVISIBLE. Under Akien's definition shelling is ALLOWED inside PURE, which makes this hole load-bearing rather than academic. Half-closed 2026-08-13: the literal argv head is resolved, and a computed argv flags the verdict *UNPROVEN rather than passing quietly. Four sites are unresolved today — tester/device.py, tester/isolation.py, sudo_relay/relay.py, skill_block/counters.py — and all four dispatch argv handed in by a caller, so closing this means following the CALLER, not the call.
(c) `SHELL_KNOWN_CLEAN` IS A JUDGEMENT, NOT A MEASUREMENT. `git` is called LLM-free because it is git. Named in the module so it can be argued with rather than trusted silently.

(d) `learning/` SITS ON NO RUNG. Found by this tool's own first run: a component with a charter and code at the repo root, born 2026-07-17, missed by the big-bang reorg — it reports rung '?'. Not moved here; a berth move is its own crossing.

(e) NO SECOND CONSUMER YET. The report is read by Akien and by this component's proofs. It is not wired into the emit chokepoint and gates nothing, so it is an instrument, not yet a gate — and the record does not dress it as one.

(f) SLEEP IS A CONCEPT WITH ONE MENTION. Akien: 'an LLM is called periodically, such as during SLEEP (we do have that idea)'. The corpus mentions it once (MAP.md:1042, 'the sleep consolidation is the same — a probe the PROVED graze sets'). This tool now names the MOSTLY band after it, which is more weight than the concept currently carries anywhere else.
gates: proof gate — proofs/test_determinism.py under the tester (11 teeth). Durability gate: committed + pushed.
falsifier: RED on any of: (1) a component whose closure provably reaches inference_domain is reported PURE; (2) a component that reaches no LLM is reported as reaching one (a report that reds everything gets ignored, which is the failure mode of a scan nobody trusts); (3) a shell-out costs a component its purity — Akien's correction, armed as tooth (b); (4) off-box state (psycopg2, the trees) sets a verdict instead of being reported beside it; (5) a SLEEP seam's LLM reach is counted against the fire path, or is silently dropped instead of reported; (6) a seam reachable FROM the fire path is excused because of its filename; (7) the roster misses a component that holds a charter and ships code, or invents one that does not exist; (8) a clean-looking report over a tree it never read (the hollow floor — Law 8). WRONG-SHAPE SIGNAL: if the verdict stops changing when components genuinely move, the roster has quietly become a list.
proof: proofs/test_determinism.py — the three verdicts pinned on synthetic components with known reach, each paired against a tree that must NOT produce it; shelling-out pinned as costing nothing (Akien's correction); an opaque argv pinned as flagged rather than assumed innocent; off-box reach pinned as reported-not-graded; the seam split pinned in both directions; the hollow floor refusing an unread tree; the real corpus by invariant, never by snapshot count, including this tool's own purity.
owner: A TOOL HAS USERS, NOT AN OWNER (Law 6). It holds no state, so there is nothing to gate. CC writes the code and proofs; Akien owns the design — the definition of the three verdicts (which he corrected onto the LLM axis on the day it was born) and the disposition of what the report shows.
traces_to: Law 3 (nothing is known until measured — this converts a seventeen-day-old prose claim into a walk)
Law 9 (red is the default, green is earned — an assertion of inference-freedom is not an earning)
Law 4 (a rule enforced by physics; today this is the measurement, and edge (a) is the honest IOU for the enforcement)
Law 1 (the reach walk lives once, in import_sieve)
I-nexi-everywhere (fire paths are hardware; the seam is where the oracle belongs)
provenance: Born 2026-08-13, hours after the rung move, in answer to Akien's sprint: 'I have to SEE that with my own eyes before we move on to anything else.' Its first run reported build_inspector — the corpus's own post-build gate — as reaching an oracle, which was true of the component and false about the gate. Akien then re-cut its whole axis the same day, from 'does it fork' to 'where is the LLM', which moved 37 components and turned a 17-component red into 3. His CC++ on the first cut ('good idea! That's one you wouldna done back in Feb ... And I didn't have to ask') and his correction arrived within the hour of each other, which is the shape of the loop working.
